overview.getStarted: Start by registering the environmental aspects of your main activities. The assistant can suggest aspects for an activity.

aspects.title: Aspects and impacts
aspects.subtitle: How your activities, products and services interact with the environment, and which of those interactions are significant.
aspects.searchPlaceholder: Search by code, activity or aspect

aspect.suggestHint: Describe the activity above, then let the assistant suggest the aspects it usually has. Check each suggestion before you use it.
aspect.noSuggestions: No suggestions came back. Try describing the activity in more detail.
aspect.suggestionApplied: The suggestion has been filled in as a draft. Check it and add the scores.

methodSummary.sum: Score each criterion from {{ min }} to {{ max }}. The weighted scores are added up; {{ threshold }} or more is significant.
methodSummary.product: Score each criterion from {{ min }} to {{ max }}. The scores are multiplied; {{ threshold }} or more is significant.

aspect.scoreIncomplete: Score every criterion to evaluate the aspect.
aspect.overrideNotice: Significance was set by hand. The method's result is: {{ computed }}. Reason: {{ reason }}
aspect.legalNotice: A legal or other requirement applies to this aspect.
aspect.noControlsSignificant: This aspect is significant but no operational controls are described yet. Describe how it is controlled.
aspect.deleteMessage: {{ code }} will be removed from the register and its open tasks cancelled. The history is kept.

plans.title: Emergency plans
plans.subtitle: How you prepare for and respond to emergencies that could harm people or the environment, and the drills that test the response.
plans.searchPlaceholder: Search by code, title or scenario

plan.draftNeedsScenario: Describe the scenario first, so the assistant knows what to plan for.
plan.draftTitle: Suggested response procedure (check and adapt it before use)
plan.scheduleDrills: Schedule drills as a recurring task for the owner
plan.noProcedure: No response procedure has been written yet.
plan.deleteMessage: {{ code }} will be removed and its drill schedule stopped. The drill records and history are kept.

drill.title: Record a drill or event
drill.none: No drills recorded yet. Test the plan with a drill or a tabletop exercise.
drill.deleteMessage: The drill will be removed from the plan's record.

metrics.title: Monitoring and measurement
metrics.subtitle: Energy, water, waste, emissions and materials, measured over time so you can see the trend and your carbon footprint.

metric.scheduleCollection: Remind the owner to record a value on a schedule
metric.trendEmpty: No measurements in this period yet.
metric.retiredNotice: This metric is retired. Existing measurements are kept, but no new ones can be recorded.
metric.deleteMessage: {{ code }} and its collection reminders will be removed. The history is kept.

measurement.title: Record a measurement
measurement.deleteMessage: The value will be removed from the trend and the emissions totals.

emissions.title: Greenhouse gas emissions
emissions.subtitle: Emissions by scope and by metric, worked out from your measurements and their emission factors.

scoring.title: Significance scoring method
scoring.subtitle: How aspects are scored and when an aspect counts as significant. One method applies to the whole organisation.
scoring.defaultNotice: You are using the default method. Adjust it to fit your organisation, then save.
scoring.maxScore: The highest possible score is {{ max }}.
scoring.legalRule: An aspect with a legal or other requirement is always significant
scoring.emergencyRule: An aspect under emergency conditions is always significant
scoring.confirmMessage: Saving re-evaluates every aspect with the new method. Changes in score or significance are recorded in each aspect's history.

errors.scaleMin: Use a whole number from 0 to 99.
errors.scaleMax: Use a whole number from 1 to 100.
errors.notAboveMin: The highest score must be above the lowest.
errors.threshold: Enter a number of 0 or more.
errors.key: Use a unique key of lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
errors.label: Give the criterion a name.
errors.weight: Use a weight above 0 and up to 10.
errors.server: This value was not accepted. Check it and try again.

review.title: Mark as reviewed
review.message: Confirm that the record is still correct and set the date of the next review.

reasons.score: The score is at or above the threshold

common.loadFailed: The environmental data could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

ask.overview: Summarise our environmental performance: significant aspects, emergency preparedness, overdue reviews and drills, and the emissions trend. What should we focus on?
ask.scoring: How should I score this aspect against our significance criteria? Explain each criterion with an example.
ask.summariseAspect: Summarise this environmental aspect: its impact, why it is or is not significant, and whether the operational controls are adequate.
ask.explainSignificance: Explain why this aspect is or is not significant under our scoring method, and what would change the result.
ask.summarisePlan: Summarise this emergency plan and tell me what is missing for a good response under ISO 14001 8.2.
ask.drillLessons: What do the drills recorded for this plan tell us, and what should we improve in the plan?
ask.explainTrend: Explain the trend of this metric and suggest what could be driving it.
ask.emissionFactor: Which emission factor (kg CO₂e per {{ unit }}) should I use for this metric, and where can I find a reliable source?
ask.emissions: Explain our greenhouse gas emissions for {{ year }} by scope and suggest where we could reduce them.
ask.scoringMethod: How should we set up our significance scoring method for environmental aspects? Suggest criteria, a scale and a threshold.
